findings.evidence: The body `simpa only [starRingEnd_apply] using hK.isHermitian.apply _ _` (or its `RCLike.star_def` variant) appears at Matrix/PosSemidef.lean:190 and :219 — inside the file that owns this API — plus Kernel/Bounds.lean:71, Kernel/Finsupp.lean:250, Kernel/Kolmogorov.lean:82 and :145, Kernel/Radical.lean:127, SemigroupGroup/Basic.lean:229 and :265, Time/Axis.lean:79, Time/Slice.lean:83. Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/Matrix/Hermitian.lean:62 confirms `IsHermitian.apply : star (A j i) = A i j`, i.e. only the star form is available upstream.
findings.fix: Add `theorem conj_apply_of_posSemidef {K : α → α → 𝕜} (hK : Matrix.PosSemidef K) (a b : α) : conj (K a b) = K b a := by simpa only [starRingEnd_apply] using hK.isHermitian.apply b a` and use it at all 11 sites.

findings.evidence: PositiveDefinite/Basic.lean:275-284 (`IsPositiveDefinite.sum`) and SemigroupGroup/Basic.lean:348-358 (`IsSemigroupGroupPD.sum`) each contain the identical four-line `have heq : (∑ i ∈ s, fun a b => ...) = fun a b => ∑ i ∈ s, ...` / `exact heq ▸ h` block against `Matrix.posSemidef_sum`, while their `prod` counterparts (Basic.lean:286-291, SemigroupGroup/Basic.lean:361-367) are one-liners. Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/Matrix/PosDef.lean:148-150 confirms the matrix-valued conclusion.
findings.fix: Add `theorem posSemidef_finset_sum {ι} {s : Finset ι} {K : ι → α → α → 𝕜} (hK : ∀ i ∈ s, Matrix.PosSemidef (K i)) : Matrix.PosSemidef (fun a b => ∑ i ∈ s, K i a b)` beside the product lemma, and call it from both sites.
findings.issue: `posSemidef_schur_finset_prod` gives the function-form finite product, but there is no function-form finite sum. Mathlib's `Matrix.posSemidef_sum` concludes about the matrix-valued `∑ i ∈ s, x i`, not `fun a b => ∑ i ∈ s, K i a b`, so both in-repo sum consumers open-code the same transport.

summary: The migration is clean — no compatibility aliases survive, helpers stay private, and the prior name-clash finding is fixed. Two API gaps remain: the replacement file omits the conjugate-symmetry accessor (open-coded at 11 sites, twice inside the owning file) and omits the function-form finite-sum companion to `posSemidef_schur_finset_prod`.
